purpose: Teach: 端子/ボルト/区画/キャップ/ポンプ/累積/買取/格納

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不審な端子部品を押収しました
lines.en: We've seized some suspicious terminal components as evidence.
lines.style: Professional, measured tone. Clear enunciation on the key details. Steady pacing—this is procedural information delivered with quiet authority, not urgency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、ボルトの種類を分析されたんですね
lines.en: I see. So you've analyzed the type of bolts involved.
lines.style: Attentive, deferential. Nodding slightly in the voice—showing he's following along and respecting the officer's expertise. Warm but not familiar.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、立入禁止区画を設定いたしました
lines.en: We've also cordoned off the restricted area at the scene.
lines.style: Factual, unhurried delivery. Each phrase lands with deliberate weight. The tone of someone who has done this many times and does it well.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、押収品のキャップ部分も検査されたんですね
lines.en: Understood. And you inspected the cap assembly from the seized materials as well.
lines.style: Slightly more engaged now—he's following the chain of investigation. Respectful but growing confidence in the conversation. Still deferred to the officer's authority.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場のポンプも証拠として確認しました
lines.en: We've also documented the pump from the site as evidence.
lines.style: Even-keeled, informative. Slight pause after 'pump'—letting the significance settle. Professional cadence maintained throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、累積被害件数を発表されますね
lines.en: Thank you. And you'll be releasing the count of affected cases to the public, I assume.
lines.style: More tentative here—phrasing it almost as a question, though he understands the procedure. Respectful uncertainty, not doubt.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、買取り業者への調査も進めております
lines.en: We're also pursuing an investigation into the recycling vendors involved.
lines.style: Steady, forward-looking tone. 'Pursuing' gets a light emphasis—showing active progress. The confidence of ongoing work, not defensive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。証拠物を安全に格納してくださりありがたいです
lines.en: Thank you for securing the evidence so carefully. I'm grateful for the thoroughness.
lines.style: Warm, genuine. Softer attack than before—this is sincere appreciation, not protocol. Slight slowness on 'carefully' and 'grateful,' showing he means it.
